decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - That details of tree planting pursuant to condition 11 of approval, ref 00423/56/P4 for the erection of a four storey side extension and conversion of the existing house to 4 x 1 bedroom flats and 4 x 2 bedroom flats incorporating replacement windows vehicle/ pedestrian access, eight parking spaces, (3 0f which are covered), covered cycle stands, refuse storage area and landscaping, dated 25 July 2002, received 3 August 2007 be approved.
description: Following approval for erection of 4 storey side extension and conversion of existing dwellinghouse to 4x1 bedroom flats and 4x2 bedroom flats incorporating replacement windows vehicular/pedestrian access, 8 parking spaces (3 of which are covered) covered cycle stands, refuse storage area and landscaping details submitted pursuant to Condition 11(details proposed tree planting) of approved planning permission dated 25/7/2002
